_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and set "openlara" to your own OpenLara checkout -- the folder holding src/platform/gba. It is only ever read; everything this project produces stays here. JSON needs each backslash of a Windows path doubled, or just use forward slashes. The other paths are relative to this file.
_devkitpro: Optional. Only needed when the toolchain is not where its installer put it and DEVKITPRO is unset. Point it at the folder holding devkitARM/gba_rules.
